name: RPVS (Slovak Register of Public Sector Partners)
summary: Slovakia's Register of Public Sector Partners: companies and persons receiving public money, their beneficial owners, public officials and the authorized persons who verify them, from the Ministry of Justice's open OData API.
notes: Keyless, run by the Slovak Ministry of Justice. An OData API: query options are $filter, $skip and $expand, and lists come back as {"@odata.context", "value": [...]}.
Property names in filters are PascalCase as in responses (Ico, ObchodneMeno, CisloVlozky, Priezvisko); strings take single quotes.
Each list also has a /$count form that returns the number of matching records. Field names and values are in Slovak.

endpoints.name: Search public sector partners
endpoints.summary: Registered partner entries (company or person) with name, IČO, legal form, address and validity, filtered by IČO, name or insert number.

filter.description: OData filter on PascalCase properties, e.g. Ico eq '31322832', CisloVlozky eq 10, contains(ObchodneMeno,'SLOVNAFT').

expand.description: Nested entities to include, e.g. Partner.

notes: Each change of a partner's details is a separate entry with PlatnostOd/PlatnostDo; PlatnostDo null is the current one. Expand Partner to get the register Id (CisloVlozky) for partners.get.

endpoints.name: Get a partner with its owners
endpoints.summary: One registered partner with all linked records: its entries, beneficial owners (KUV), authorized persons, public officials, deletions and fines.

key.description: Partner Id, as Partner.Id in partners.search results with $expand=Partner.

notes: Without $expand only Id and CisloVlozky come back; expand the linked records you need.

endpoints.name: List beneficial owners
endpoints.summary: Beneficial owners (konečný užívateľ výhod) recorded in the register, with name, date of birth, nationality, public-official flag and validity.

filter.description: OData filter on PascalCase properties, e.g. Ico eq '31322832', CisloVlozky eq 10, contains(ObchodneMeno,'SLOVNAFT').

expand.description: Nested entities to include, e.g. Partner.

notes: Filter by the partner, e.g. $filter=Partner/CisloVlozky eq 10, or by name; expand Partner to see whose owner each record is.

endpoints.name: List public officials linked to partners
endpoints.summary: Public officials (verejní funkcionári) recorded against partners in the register.

endpoints.name: List authorized persons
endpoints.summary: Authorized persons (oprávnené osoby) recorded in the register against partners.
